question: Two spherical bodies $A$ (radius $6 \mathrm{~cm}$ ) and $B$ (radius $18 \mathrm{~cm}$ ) are at temperatures $T_1$ and $T_2$, respectively. & E \propto T^4 A \text { (where } A=\text { surface area } \\

& =(3)^4\left(\frac{6}{18}\right)^2=9
\end{aligned}
$$
$\therefore$ Answer is 9 .
